BAD EXPERIENCE EVER!
Sep 2023 • Couples
BAD EXPERIENCE EVER!
This restaurant is the small one, quite cozy and guests should have the reservation in advance. We have the booking at 20:15, but when we come, we have to wait for 15 mins in the outdoor terrace. It's okie!
The father of owner is very friendly and outgoing. Staffs are nice.
The food is good.
HOWEVER, the thing damages all my good feeling is WE HAVE TO PAY FOR 02 LEMONSODA just because I ask for some lemon pieces. In ordering, I prefer my lemonsoda "less sugar, and more lemon", I ask them kindly to separate the sugar for me, so I myself can adjust the sweetness in my drinking. And then, I do ask for some more lemon pieces to make it more sour.
Upon the payment, I see there are 2 lemonsoda in the bill. And the answer I receive from the female staff, and supervisor (they come 2 times, for the explanation why have to I pay double) is the extra some lemon piece is chargeable. The lemonsoda is not refilled, and when I ask for some lemon pieces, it is considered my drink refilled, and 2 lemonsoda should be paid.
My bill is 2.289.600 vnd (~100usd/2 persons), and they ask me to pay DOUBLE for the drink just because of some extra lemon pieces. If so, I hope that if they want to charge double when I ask for this small request (so silly thing!!!), they should inform me first, instead of making me so SHOCKED due to some lemon piece EXTRA CHARGE. ( I just wonder the guest experience is cheaper than a lemon's price????). 40,000vnd is not a big amout of money, but the way of such service IS NOT NICE AT ALL, espcially in Japanse culture. I expect something nicer and better from Japanese hospitality.
I feel SO BAD, and I will never come back again

reviews.review_text:
stevehuynh
Orange County, California9 contributions
1
Not worth the price!
Feb 2023 • Couples
Came here on a recommendation from the locals; plus, the reviews looked good so I decided to give it a try. Definitely need reservation before hand and make sure you ask for seats at the sushi bar if you want to experience omakase close up.
1. Service was good. Our server was attentive. Explanations of the dishes were a bit too fast but were all right over all.
2. Omakase: fishes were okay, not great, fresh, but not a refreshing level of fresh. If you know you know. Rice was undercooked. The otoro cut wasn’t good which left some connective tissue on the edges causing it to be a bit chewy. Again, very disappointed with the undercooked rice which was a big let down to us. Half of the menu was sashimi & sushi and the other half was cooked fish and other dishes. I expect omakase to be 90% on the sushi side.
3. Considering the presentations, quality of foods, this place is not worth the price. At all. Sorry. Omakase should include element of surprise this place gave us a set menu. This is not omakase.
Foods coming up too fast! It might be a Vietnamese thing where people like their food to come up immediately but for omakase it needs to take time! Slow down when you serve your foods! You are not a fast food restaurant.
4. There were a group of Americans with a blonde and 2 dudes sitting at the bar today Jan 04th with the second sitting of the night who were very annoying and obnoxious, especially the blonde. She was too loud and obnoxious and in the restaurant there was no other voices except this one. If you are reading this review, please make sure you check yourself and be considerate of other diners in the room. Lower your voice, please. Act classy, people.
5. Lastly, when receiving a legitimate complain, Manager should do something about those obnoxious guests not just brush it off. Over all, I would never come back here the second time. Huge disappointment.

Written February 5, 2023

NOT WORTH IT! You pay a tonne and leave still hungry!
Apr 2019 • Friends
This is a small, intimate - yet ridiculously pretentious - sushi/sashimi place in a less known small area of Japanese restaurants and bars. We had the set sashimi menu (costing about 50 USD/person, which is high for HCMC) and some pricey sake to go with it. The fish was nothing special and the servings were all, at best, starter size - having spent over 100 USD / person, everyone left hungry! There are far better places costing far less in fx. Le Tan Ton street or go to one of the Hokkaido Sushi restaurants.
